name: @haoliplus/pi-packages
description: Private Pi extensions maintained by haoliplus, forked from gotgenes/pi-packages

scripts.prepare: command -v prek >/dev/null 2>&1 && prek install || echo 'prek not found — skipping hook install (see README)'
scripts.lint: biome check . && eslint packages/ && rumdl check . && node scripts/lint/invisible-characters.mjs && node scripts/lint/unicode-escapes.mjs
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write . && eslint packages/ --fix && rumdl fmt . && node scripts/lint/invisible-characters.mjs --fix && node scripts/lint/unicode-escapes.mjs --fix
